Prerequisites: You do not control another Golem or have a Golem in your graveyard.
  You have another creature card in hand that is not a Golem and that does not share a creature type with a creature you control or a creature in your graveyard.

Steps: Cast the additional creature by paying its mana cost.
  Volo triggers, copying the creature spell.
  Resolve both creature spells.
  Activate Food Chain by exiling the creature token, adding at least one mana of any color that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
  Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
  Volo triggers, copying Ancestral Statue.
  Resolve the copy of the Ancestral Statue spell.
  When the token Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning a nontoken creature from the battlefield to your hand.
  Activate Food Chain by exiling the Ancestral Statue token, adding five mana of any color that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
  Resolve the original Ancestral Statue spell cast in step 5.
  When the nontoken Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
  Repeat.

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}{U}
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite blue mana; Infinite copies of permanents you control; Infinite Island tokens; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite storm count; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Orvar, the All-Form (battlefield); Ghostly Flicker (hand); Stone-Seeder Hierophant (battlefield); Salvager of Secrets (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
  Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Steps: Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing land.
  Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
  When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
  Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
  Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
  Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
  Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
  Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Salvager of Secrets.
  When the land and Salvager of Secrets enter the battlefield, Salvager of Secrets and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
  Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
  Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
  Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
  Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

Produces: Infinite colorless mana; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite self-mill; Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield; Infinite blinking; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite storm count; Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0
Start: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Famished Worldsire (battlefield); Eldrazi Confluence (hand); Stone-Seeder Hierophant (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Archaeomancer (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
  Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire.
  As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
  When Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
  Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
  When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
  Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
  Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
  Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
  Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
  Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
  Repeat from step 1.
Notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Archaeomancer and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 5 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{U}
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite landfall triggers; Near-infinite creature LTB
Start: Ignis Scientia (hand); Deadeye Navigator (battlefield: is paired with Ignis); Tiller Engine (battlefield); Lotus Cobra (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
  When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
  Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
  Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield.
  If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Lotus Cobra and Tiller Engine trigger.
  Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
  Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land that entered
  Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
  Repeat.
Notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.

Start: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Famished Worldsire (battlefield); Eldrazi Confluence (hand); Tiller Engine (battlefield); Archaeomancer (battlefield)

Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
  Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire.

  Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
  When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
  Repeat.
Notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Donnie & April and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 2 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}
Produces: Infinite tapped creature tokens; Infinite proliferate; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite landfall triggers
Requires: Haste Enabler (battlefield)
Start: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams (battlefield); Evolution Sage (battlefield); Guildless Commons (hand); Walking Atlas (hand)
Prerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
Steps: Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
  Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
  Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
  Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
  Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
  Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
  Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
  Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
  Repeat from step 2.

## Combo 430-2567-4768
Cards: Esix, Fractal Bloom + Avenger of Zendikar + Altar of the Brood
Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 87 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {5}{G}{G}
Produces: Infinite mill; Near-infinite creature tokens; Near-infinite creature ETB
Start: Esix, Fractal Bloom (battlefield); Avenger of Zendikar (hand); Altar of the Brood (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Each opponent has no more than ninety-one cards in their library.
  You control at least nine lands.
  You have not created a token this turn.
Steps: Cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
  When Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, it and Altar of the Brood triggers.
  Resolve the Altar of the Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
  Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar for each land you control due to Esik.
  Each Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, triggering themselves and triggering Altar of the Brood once for each token.
  Resolve all Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill that many cards.
  Resolve the first Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
  When the Plants enter the battlefield, Altar of the Brood triggers that many times, causing each opponent to mill that many cards.
  Repeat from step 7 for each remaining Avenger of Zendikar trigger.

## Combo 703-2665-7149
Cards: Princess Yue + Astral Dragon + Progenitor Mimic
Color identity: GU | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 7 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature token copies of all noncreature permanents; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers
Start: Princess Yue (battlefield: is not a land); Astral Dragon (battlefield); Progenitor Mimic (battlefield)
Steps: Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
  Put Progenitor Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  When Progenitor Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
  When Progenitor Mimic enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.

  The Progenitor Mimic tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
  Repeat from step 5.
Notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

Cards: Ghostly Flicker + Mystic Sanctuary + Time Stretch + Greenwarden of Murasa
Color identity: GU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 3 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {8}{U} at most each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Skip your draw steps; Lock
Start: Ghostly Flicker (hand); Mystic Sanctuary (battlefield); Time Stretch (hand); Greenwarden of Murasa (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
Steps: Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
  Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
  Move to your first extra turn.
  Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
  Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Greenwarden of Murasa.
  When Greenwarden of Murasa and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
  Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
  Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
  Repeat.
